notes.aoi: Shapefile, GeoJSON, feature class, or a 'minx,miny,maxx,maxy' bounding box. Any geometry type; points and lines are buffered automatically. One mosaic per feature.
notes.output_folder: Folder where GDB and mosaic datasets will be saved.
notes.cloud_cover: Maximum scene cloud cover percentage (0-100), measured over the whole tile.
notes.area_name: Prefix added to all output mosaic names. Leave empty for no prefix.
notes.mrf_cache_folder: Local folder for MRF tile cache. Must have sufficient disk space.
notes.name_field: Optional: AOI field to use as the mosaic name. Leave empty for Feature_1, Feature_2, ...
notes.aoi_buffer_meters: Optional: expand each AOI by this many metres before searching.
notes.scene_selection: all | best_scene_only | date_coherent. best_scene_only keeps the clearest scene per tile whatever its date. Use date_coherent only when one mosaic must represent a single moment.
notes.template_packs: ['all'] or any of: imagery, vegetation, water, fire, urban, geology, snow.
notes.months: Optional: month numbers to include (e.g. [6,7,8]). Leave [] for all months in the date range.
